preflight: verify exact PR #572 head/base and expected commit before any write
dirty_tree_policy: If worktree is dirty or branch/head differs, do not reset/clean/stash/checkout over it. Capture status and stop write operations. Create an isolated child worktree only after confirming no collision and preserving user changes.

gates.name: minimal code mutation
deny: change theory only to pass tests

gates.name: numerical and statistical verification
require: SBC/PPC/coverage and actual chain diagnostics as applicable

rules: Do not include secrets/raw data; use local references and hash manifests.
NOT_RUN must be explicit, never null or silently omitted.
A pass receipt binds exact branch/commit and inputs.

self_audit: Every numerical coefficient has a derivation, source, calibration receipt or is typed as a free nuisance; otherwise remove it or mark UNAVAILABLE.
Every tensor carries rank, symmetry, units, basis, parity, tetrad/frame, epoch and rotation law.
Every datum has official release URL, retrieval time, actual byte size/SHA256, parser identity, row IDs/order, units, coordinate frame, mask/window/selection and covariance identity.
Every claimed independent probe has an overlap/shared-calibration/common-LSS/cross-covariance analysis.
Every mock is labelled SYNTHETIC_ONLY and has fixed seed, spec, covariance, generator, metrics and MC uncertainty.
Every claimed execution has an exact command and exit code. A source file, workflow definition or PR state does not mean runtime success.
Every claim is checked against its closest prior art and contradictory/negative evidence.
Five outputs x,Q,Pi,F,G_F come from one posterior; never multiply marginals as independent likelihood.
Bianchi-I endpoint template never silently becomes Bianchi V/VIIh transfer or present-shear inference.
A single dipole never proves global tilt; Gaia B1 never proves vorticity without frame-spin tie.
If data/transfer missing, mark only dependent operator/claim BLOCKED or UNAVAILABLE and continue independent theory lanes.
Preserve failed attempts and previous claims as superseded/quarantined; never rewrite evidence history.
execution_sequence: CORE-00 exact checkout and clean worktree preflight
STAT-43 through STAT-46 exact mock/theorem replay if source identity differs
L1 then L2 then L3 then L4 then L5 then L6, one task per context
CORE-04 source acquisition and single-observable operator validation
CORE-05 joint likelihood and five-view posterior push-forward
CORE-06 generative-model x readout-method benchmark registry
CORE-09 independent review and per-claim publication decision
